name: cloudtak-plugin-address-search
description: CloudTAK plugin: local-first address search over an OpenAddresses-derived pack, with an optional online fallback.
comment: Runtime dependencies are intentionally absent. lib/ is the code that will eventually ship as part of the browser plugin bundle (Phase 3+), resolved against api/web's own node_modules per the measure-plugin convention — see docs/PLAN.md §8.7/§9.1. It also runs unmodified under Node for the Phase 2 bench harness in bench/, using Node's native Web Crypto (crypto.subtle) and Streams (DecompressionStream) APIs instead of a Node-only sha256/gzip path, so there is exactly one pack-reading implementation, not two. typescript/vitest/fake-indexeddb are devDependencies only — fake-indexeddb exists purely so lib/storage/'s tests can run under Node, which has no native `indexedDB` global; it is never imported by lib/storage/ itself, only loaded as a vitest setupFile.
